## Default colors

::: {.codewindow .r}
analysis.R
```r
library(dplyr)

penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(mass = mean(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE))
```
:::

## Per-window arguments

::: {.codewindow .sass bg="#fdf6e3" header-bg="#eee8d5" tab-bg="#d9d2ba" color="#073642" shadow-color="#93a1a1"}
styles.scss
```scss
.pink {
  color: pink;
}
```
:::

## Deck-wide custom properties

```{=html}
<style>
.reveal .deck-wide .codewindow {
  --codewindow-bg: #fdf6e3;
  --codewindow-header-bg: #eee8d5;
  --codewindow-tab-bg: #d9d2ba;
  --codewindow-tab-active-bg: #fdf6e3;
  --codewindow-color: #073642;
  --codewindow-shadow-color: #93a1a1;
}
</style>
```

::: {.deck-wide}
::: {.codewindow .r}
analysis.R
```r
mean(1:10)
```
:::

::: {.codewindow .python}
analysis.py
```python
sum(range(10)) / 10
```
:::
:::
